title: Skin, Homeostasis, and Medical Case Evidence
purpose: Use case evidence to explain integumentary function and health.
required_visual_model_data: Skin condition case table; homeostasis diagram

direct_resource.Title: NIAMS: Skin Health
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the skin-diseases page as a public health source. Observe how skin structure connects to health. Record one skin function, one disease or condition category, and one evidence-based prevention or care idea.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
